description: The local update-status dialog (frontend/update.html): core IPC for the updater commands, event listen for the updater:// broadcasts, and — from the webview — hide (the close button calls getCurrentWindow().hide()) + start-dragging (data-tauri-drag-region). show and set-focus are only invoked Rust-side (updater::open_update_window), which bypasses the webview ACL, so they're dropped.
